hook.name: EulerSwap
hook.description: A custom curve AMM hook that routes swaps entirely through Euler Finance lending vaults. In beforeSwap, it computes swap amounts using a custom curve invariant, takes input tokens from the PoolManager into the Euler vault, withdraws output tokens from the Euler vault back to the PoolManager, and returns a full BeforeSwapDelta — bypassing Uniswap v4's standard concentrated liquidity pricing.
